Follow the skill definition and authored language and variety guidance below. Count correct use of at least one function in this skill group. Small mistakes elsewhere in the reply are okay. ## Coordinating action
Request, propose and negotiate shared or individual action.
Boundary: Require a successful request, proposal, commitment or response about action. Merely describing a desire or future event is insufficient.

Assess requests, offers or invitations, suggestions, commitments, acceptance or refusal, and negotiation. Bu kutuyu kapıya taşıyın, lütfen requests action with a polite or plural imperative. Çantanızı taşıyayım mı? offers to carry the listener’s bag. Biraz ara verelim proposes a shared break. Aletleri yarın getireceğim can undertake an assigned task, while an unrelated future prediction is not automatically a promise. Bugün gelemem can decline an invitation; Cumartesi buluşalım proposes an alternative. Olur contextually accepts a concrete proposal, not every preceding assertion. An isolated copied lütfen without a recoverable action is absent. A modal question may be a request rather than a genuine ability inquiry. Judge who is to act and whether a workable contribution to coordination is made, allowing ordinary pronoun omission and contextually polite forms.

## Feelings and viewpoints
Express internal states, evaluations and positions.
Boundary: Require a correctly expressed feeling, desire, preference or position. An ordinary factual assertion is not automatically an opinion.

Assess desire or intention, preference, emotion, opinion and agreement. Dikiş dikmeyi öğrenmek istiyorum names a desire rather than a commitment. Çayı kahveye tercih ediyorum expresses a preference with an accusative preferred item and dative alternative. Bu habere sevindim reports an emotional response. Bence frames a judgment; Bu öneriye katılmıyorum rejects a proposal. Anladım acknowledges understanding without necessarily agreeing. Çay can choose a preferred drink contextually; its presence in a shopping list is not preference evidence. A copied istiyorum with no recoverable desired action is absent. Do not count neutral factual reporting as opinion solely because the speaker asserts it. Turkish does not require gender agreement in these forms. Preserve natural omitted pronouns and check the relevant complement or case construction without withholding all evidence because of an unrelated spelling mistake.

## Information exchange
Seek, supply and verify information relevant to the exchange.
Boundary: Require successful information seeking or a relevant informative response. Question-shaped requests for action do not qualify just for their form.

Look for actual questions, relevant answers, fact checking and useful detail. Atölye saat kaçta kapanıyor? asks a closing time; Beşte answers contextually. Atölye beşte kapanıyor, değil mi? checks a candidate fact. The separate question particle follows vowel harmony, but a content question with kaç does not require an extra mı. Bana yardım edebilir misiniz? normally requests help rather than merely collecting an ability fact. Avlu tarafındaki kapı identifies which entrance to use if that distinction is needed. Extra words alone are not useful detail. A copied question particle with no recoverable question is absent. Ne demek istediniz? repairs interpretation of an earlier contribution. Preserve short answers and ordinary subject omission, and do not infer a missing conversational antecedent when it is unavailable. Distinguish the function of the question from its surface form.

## Managing conversation
Establish contact, coordinate turns and repair mutual understanding.
Boundary: Require a successful opening, response, turn/topic action or repair. Sending any message or quoting a greeting does not automatically qualify.

Assess opening or closing contact, acknowledgement, clarification, rephrasing, correcting misunderstanding and turn or topic management. Gelecek hafta görüşürüz closes an exchange with expected future contact. Şimdi anladım acknowledges understanding without necessarily agreement. Tekrar söyler misiniz? requests repetition of the preceding contribution. Başka bir deyişle introduces a reformulation. Cuma değil, cumartesi demek istedim corrects the listener’s interpretation. Başka bir soruya geçebilir miyiz? requests a conversational transition, not merely an external permission. A copied greeting in a vocabulary list is absent as interactional evidence. A brief tamam can acknowledge a specific explanation contextually, but its function depends on the exchange. Do not invent an antecedent, require long repair sentences or equate all questions with clarification. Preserve successful short and formulaic expressions when they do real conversational work.

## People, things, and places
Establish referents and describe properties, locations, quantities and relationships.
Boundary: Require an identifiable referent and a correctly expressed property, spatial relation, quantity or relationship. Naming alone does not demonstrate every function in this group.

Assess identification, properties, location or movement, possession or relationships, and quantity or comparison. Bu benim komşum identifies a person; Bu sokak dar predicates a property without mandatory third-person -dır. Anahtar rafta locates an object with the locative; kapıya marks a destination. İki sandalyem var expresses possession with a possessive suffix and var. Turkish normally keeps the counted noun singular after a numeral; iki sandalye is not missing an English plural. Bundan daha hafif compares weight using an ablative standard. Rafta can answer a where-question contextually. A copied case ending or disconnected noun list is absent. Do not impose grammatical gender, obligatory pronouns or rigid verb-final order where ordinary discourse permits another order. Judge meaningful case, possessive and harmony distinctions in the construction rather than requiring every sentence to reproduce the guide’s exact wording.

# Skill assessment

## Possibilities and constraints
Express capability, permission, requirements and epistemic limits.
Boundary: Distinguish ability, permission, obligation and likelihood. Similar wording can serve a request instead; judge the actual function.

Recognize ability, permission, obligation, possibility and confidence. The -abil/-ebil family can express different modal meanings according to context. Bisiklet tamir edebiliyorum describes capability, while Çantamı burada bırakabilir miyim? can ask permission from the space’s owner. Anahtarı bugün geri vermem gerekiyor states necessity; gerek yok removes need rather than prohibiting the action. Akşam yağmur yağabilir gives possibility. Gelmeyebilir means someone may not come, unlike gelemeyebilir, which can mean they may be unable to come. Emin değilim limits confidence. Olur can grant a prior permission request contextually. A copied modal ending with no recoverable proposition is absent. A polite ability-shaped request does not necessarily assert capability. Do not label a correctly formed modal unclear solely because ability and opportunity are both plausible and both establish the group.

## Reasons and connections
Relate propositions through explanation, consequence, condition, contrast and support.
Boundary: Require a correctly expressed relationship between ideas. Sequence alone is not causation, a condition or an argument.

Assess reasons, consequences, conditions, contrast and support for claims. Çünkü introduces a reason; bu yüzden presents a consequence. Yarın yağmur yağarsa evde kalacağız makes staying home conditional, with the condition carried by -sa rather than requiring a separate eğer. Ama contrasts properties. Önce and sonra alone indicate order, not necessarily cause. An illuminated window can support an occupancy inference without causing the occupancy. Çünkü yağmur başladı can answer an identifiable why-question contextually. A copied connector or conditional ending without recoverable connected content is absent. Check whether evidence actually supports the claim. Do not demand an English conjunction pattern where Turkish uses a suffixed clause, and do not treat every clause containing için as a cause when it may express purpose. Judge the intended connection and the forms that establish it.

# Skill assessment

## Time and events
Locate events in time and express their temporal structure.
Boundary: One correctly expressed temporal relationship is sufficient. Present properties alone do not establish temporal skill. Judge meaning in context, not a tense label.

Assess current, past and future events, duration or frequency, sequencing and event phase. Şimdi bisikleti tamir ediyorum presents an ongoing repair. Dün bisikleti tamir ettim uses a past form; Turkish does not mark the speaker’s gender on it. Yarın parçaları alacağım places collection in the future. Reported or inferred -miş forms should not be rejected merely because a direct past form was expected. Haftada iki kez gives recurrence, while iki saat can measure duration. Önce and sonra order actions; okumayı bitirdim specifies completion of reading. Dün can answer a recoverable when-question contextually. A copied time adverb without an identifiable event is absent. A bare property statement does not establish temporal skill. Preserve natural pronoun omission and assess suffix combinations in context; -iyor can also occur with planned future reference when the surrounding time expression establishes it.
